title: A first-person arena
hints: Write the three axis passes as three copies of the same block first; once the tests pass, you can fold them into one helper that takes the axis.
For `shoot`, walls and targets compete for the nearest distance; remember whether the current best is a wall (index -1) or a target.
requirements: Mouse look wraps the yaw and clamps the pitch.
Walking follows the view, with normalised diagonals, and stops at walls in both horizontal directions.
The player falls, lands, jumps about 1.17 m at 60 steps per second, and bumps their head on low ceilings.
Shots hit the nearest live target unless a wall is in the way.
stretch: Add moving targets on a back-and-forth path, a crosshair that turns red over a target (the same ray, every frame), and a score with a timer for a 60-second round.
